name: Mechatronic
description: Builds a [color=#E92031]Redstone Golem[/color] that fights beside you. [color=#E92031]Golem Mode[/color]: right click summons it or uses its Super Move, left click gives orders, Sneak + right click recalls it.

badge.name: Redstone Golem
badge.description: Summons a [color=#E92031]Redstone Golem[/color]. Enemies within 12 blocks target it instead of you, and it wears your armor. [color=#E92031]Golem Mode[/color]: right click summons it or uses its Super Move; left click orders it (creature: attack, block: hold, Sneak: follow); Sneak + right click recalls it. Running straight, it drops to all fours and builds speed (Stride). Hold Jump in the air to rocket up, keep holding to glide. Rebuilt 60s after it breaks down.

commons.name: Redstone Furnace
commons.description: Hits and Super Moves heat its redstone. At full signal it overheats for 6s: 50% faster, and its blows set targets on fire.

commons.name: Saddle
commons.description: Right click the Golem to ride it. Jump: jump or rocket. Left click: its lift. Right click: its Super Move. Sneak: get off.

adept.name: Piston Arm
adept.description: Super Move: a powered two-fist slam, 14 damage to everything within 4 blocks in front. Cooldown 6s.

adept.name: Dispenser Arm
adept.description: Super Move: a bolt from each arm cannon, 6 damage, homing on the target and the enemy nearest it. Cooldown 5s.

master.name: Ministrosities
master.description: Each overheat builds 3 Ministrosities that fight beside it (3 at most). They fall apart when it is recalled or breaks down.

master.name: Redstone Arcs
master.description: While overheated, its hits arc to up to 3 more enemies within 6 blocks for 4 damage.

grandmaster.name: Stride Servos
grandmaster.description: Stride builds faster and goes further: 1.9x speed in 1.2s (1.5x in 2s without).

grandmaster.name: Rocket Boots
grandmaster.description: Rockets fire longer and climb faster: 2.4s of thrust (1.6s without).
